text_en: After these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, “Do not be afraid, Abram, I am your shield; your reward shall be very great. ”
text_cn: 这些事以后，有上主的话在神视中对亚巴郎说：“亚巴郎，你不要怕，我是你的盾牌；你得的报酬必很丰厚！”

text_en: But Abram said, “O Lord God , what will you give me, for I continue childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus? ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎说：“我主上主！你能给我什么？我一直没有儿子；继承我家业的是大马士革人厄里厄则尔。”

text_en: And Abram said, “You have given me no offspring, and so a slave born in my house is to be my heir. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎又说：“你既没有赐给我后裔，那么只有一个家仆来作我的承继人。”

text_en: But the word of the Lord came to him, “This man shall not be your heir; no one but your very own issue shall be your heir. ”
text_cn: 有上主的话答复他说：“这人决不会是你的承继人，而是你亲生的要做你的承继人。”

text_en: He brought him outside and said, “Look toward heaven and count the stars, if you are able to count them. ” Then he said to him, “So shall your descendants be. ”
text_cn: 上主遂领他到外面说：“请你仰观苍天，数点星辰，你能够数清吗？”继而对他说：“你的后裔也将这样。”

text_en: And he believed the Lord ; and the Lord reckoned it to him as righteousness.
text_cn: 亚巴郎相信了上主，上主就以此算为他的正义。

text_en: Then he said to him, “I am the Lord who brought you from Ur of the Chaldeans, to give you this land to possess. ”
text_cn: 上主又对他说：“我是上主，我从加色丁人的乌尔领你出来，是为将这地赐给你作为产业。”

text_en: But he said, “O Lord God , how am I to know that I shall possess it? ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎说：“我主上主！我如何知道我要占有此地为产业？”

text_en: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon. ”
text_cn: 上主对他说：“你给我拿来一只三岁的母牛，一只三岁的母山羊，一只三岁的公绵羊，一只斑鸠和一只雏鸽。”

text_en: He brought him all these and cut them in two, laying each half over against the other; but he did not cut the birds in two.
text_cn: 亚巴郎便把这一切拿了来，每样从中剖开，将一半与另一半相对排列，只有飞鸟没有剖开。

text_en: And when birds of prey came down on the carcasses, Abram drove them away.
text_cn: 有鸷（zhì）鸟落在兽尸上，亚巴郎就把它们赶走。

text_en: As the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram, and a deep and terrifying darkness descended upon him.
text_cn: 太阳快要西落时，亚巴郎昏沉地睡去，忽觉阴森万分，遂害怕起来。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Abram, “Know this for certain, that your offspring shall be aliens in a land that is not theirs, and shall be slaves there, and they shall be oppressed for four hundred years;
text_cn: 上主对亚巴郎说：“你当知道，你的后裔必要寄居在异邦，受人奴役虐待四百年之久。

text_en: but I will bring judgment on the nation that they serve, and afterward they shall come out with great possessions.
text_cn: 但是，我要亲自惩罚他们所要服事的民族；如此你的后裔必要带着丰富的财物由那里出来。

text_en: As for yourself, you shall go to your ancestors in peace; you shall be buried in a good old age.
text_cn: 至于你，你要享受高寿，以后平安回到你列祖那里，被人埋葬。

text_en: And they shall come back here in the fourth generation; for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete. ”
text_cn: 到了第四代，他们必要回到这里，因为阿摩黎人的罪恶至今尚未满贯。”

text_en: When the sun had gone down and it was dark, a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
text_cn: 当日落天黑的时候，看，有冒烟的火炉和燃着的火炬，由那些肉块间经过。

text_en: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates,
text_cn: 在这一天，上主与亚巴郎立约说：“我要赐给你后裔的这土地，是从埃及河直到幼发拉的河，

text_en: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
text_cn: 就是刻尼人、刻纳次人、卡德摩尼人、

text_en: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
text_cn: 赫特人、培黎齐人、勒法因人、

text_en: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites. ”
text_cn: 阿摩黎人、客纳罕人、基尔加士人和耶步斯人的土地。”
